name: Zendesk
description: A comprehensive customer service platform providing ticketing, help center, chat, voice, and CRM solutions for businesses.

evidence.claim: Zendesk provides a REST API for ticketing, help center, live chat, voice, and sales CRM.
Authentication can be performed via OAuth2, API tokens, or Basic Authentication.
Community-built MCP servers exist for Zendesk to expose ticket management tools to AI agents.
Zendesk offers webhooks through its 'Webhooks' API and integration services (ZIS).

notes: Zendesk has one of the most mature API ecosystems in the SaaS space, covering Support, Guide, Chat, Talk, and Sell. Authentication typically uses OAuth2 for third-party integrations and API tokens for internal scripts.
